name: Chicken herbal stew
summary: Chicken stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs at one Bùi Thị Xuân door.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note lists gà among the tiềm pots at Tài Ký.
howToEat: The note says the pots are stewed with sâm and thuốc bắc. It does not give a recipe beyond that.
where: Tài Ký, 39 Bùi Thị Xuân. Hours are Check on arrival.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 50,000 VND a tiềm.
